newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan faction confirms loss of Sarobi to Taleban.
newsitem.headline: Afghan faction confirms loss of Sarobi to Taleban.

text.p: Sources in the pro-government Hezb-i-Islami faction confirmed on Wednesday that the key town of Sarobi had fallen to the Afghan rebel Taleban militia.
"Sarobi has fallen and Hezb-i-Islami fighters blew up an ammunition dump and some vehicles as they retreated," said a Hezb-i-Islami source in the Pakistani city of Peshawar.
The sources had no word on casualties.
Taleban sources said rebel forces had captured Sarobi on Tuesday night after advancing on two fronts towards the town, about 70 km (44 miles) east of Kabul.

They said Taleban fighters had also seized the Naghlu Dam and hydro-electric plant 10 km (six miles) west of Sarobi and were advancing northwards up the Tagab Valley towards the main government airbase at Bagram, 50 km (31 miles) north of Kabul.
